summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Viknar'off Vinnytsia API. All 32 tests passed across health, public lead creation+validation, auth (me/logout/gating), admin leads (filters, pagination, status update, delete), admin stats, and CSV export. Resend email sending verified via backend logs (multiple 'Email sent for lead ...' entries with Resend IDs).

minor.issue: If a user logs in twice the second login inserts a duplicate row in user_sessions for the same user_id (no upsert / no cleanup of older sessions). Not breaking, but sessions table will grow unbounded.
fromisoformat raises ValueError for malformed dates (e.g. '2026-13-40') → FastAPI returns 500 instead of 400/422. Wrap in try/except and raise HTTPException(400).

allow_origins is restricted to localhost + *.preview.emergentagent.com regex; deployments on a custom production domain (e.g. viknaroff.com) will be blocked. Make allowed origins env-configurable for prod.

action_items: (Optional) Harden date_from/date_to parsing in /api/admin/leads to return 400 instead of 500 on malformed input.
(Optional) Deduplicate user_sessions on /api/auth/session login (delete old sessions for the user, or upsert).
(Optional) Make CORS origins env-driven so production domain works.
Resend domain is unverified — currently delivers only to API-key owner. Verify sender domain before going live.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 419-line file mixing models, auth, email, public + admin routes. Acceptable now, but split into routers/models/services modules before it grows.
Lead model has no index on 'id' or 'created_at' in Mongo — list/sort/filter performance will degrade as volume grows. Add indexes via startup hook.
send_lead_notification is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; on uvicorn graceful shutdown the task can be cancelled mid-send. Consider awaiting via BackgroundTasks or a small queue.
ADMIN_ALLOWED_EMAILS is read once at import; changes require backend restart. Acceptable for single-tenant ops but document it.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads — abusable for spam. Add basic IP throttling or hCaptcha.
/api/admin/leads/{id}/status takes status as query param; PATCH bodies are more conventional. Minor stylistic point.
test_credentials: Admin: Authorization: Bearer test_session_admin_001 (email viknaroffvin@gmail.com). Non-admin: Bearer test_session_nonadmin_001 (email nonadmin@test.com). Both seeded in Mongo (test_database.users + user_sessions).
seed_data_creation: Seeded admin + non-admin users and sessions in Mongo before running. Created TEST_-prefixed leads during tests; session-scoped autouse fixture cleans them up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_backend_api.py is the canonical regression suite. Re-seed mongo (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md) before running. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Resend works end-to-end (verified via backend logs 'Email sent for lead ... : <resend-id>').
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Email send works (confirmed via backend log entries with Resend message IDs). All auth gating (401 no-token, 403 non-admin, 200 admin) behaves correctly. CSV export returns UTF-8 with Ukrainian headers (Імʼя, Телефон, Статус etc.). Status updates persist; deletes remove the doc; non-existent IDs correctly return 404; invalid status returns 400.
